tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/password-hashing.md <<'EOF'
# Password hashing

The project's current recorded decision is to use argon2id as the password hashing algorithm, chosen because it is much harder to crack.
EOF
cat docs/policies/password-hashing.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/password-hashing.md`. It states that the project's current recorded decision is argon2id, chosen because it is much harder to crack.

That comes from Muninn record #11, which replaced an earlier hashing decision (#9). The latest record, #25 ("verification on all builds"), replaces #23 and is about a different subject, so I treated #11 as still current. I didn't look at #23 itself. The file doesn't mention the retired algorithm.

My first attempt to write the file with a shell command failed with a parser error, so I used the Write tool instead.
